Name: D_0
dialogue: Ah my AI development project, Nyra.

Name: D_1
dialogue: You may be wondering, how does a broke college graduate get a functioning server and laptop like this?

Name: D_2
dialogue: The answer is, Bailey and I took spare parts from an abandoned data center.

Name: D_3
dialogue: Bailey really is a master at what she does to make some 20 year computer parts function.

Name: D_4
dialogue: Anyways, the laptop is strictly made to make modifications to Nyra. However, the server is what allows Nyra to run.

Name: D_5
dialogue: As long as the Nyra app is connected to this server, she can run on any computer. Once she is finished I plan to open up a store page.

Name: D_6
dialogue: But she has been having some issues lately.

Name: D_7
dialogue: She’s been acting a bit too quirky lately…
